id.description: The threat id; equals the file name.

response.description: The response the threat asks for.

telegraphDelayMs.description: From the telegraph to the opening of the window, in sim ms; `null` = `feel.timing.telegraphDelayDefaultMs`.

windowMs.description: Base response window, in sim ms; `null` = `feel.timing.windowMs`.

minDelayMs.description: Only on a `wait` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): the shortest wait, from the end of the telegraph delay to the signal, in sim ms (story 4.6).

maxDelayMs.description: Only on a `wait` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): the longest wait, from the end of the telegraph delay to the signal, in sim ms, at least `minDelayMs`. The signal falls at one random instant between the two (story 4.6).

signalVerbKey.description: Only on a `wait` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): key of `strings.fr.json` (`verb.` group) of the verb shown from the signal on (« FILE ! », story 4.6).

signalIcon.description: Only on a `wait` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): the glyph drawn in the marker from the signal on, in place of `icon` (story 4.6). The signal is the glyph and the verb, never the colour alone.

holdUntilMs.description: Only on a `firm` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): from the opening of the window to the end of the attack, in sim ms. A Firmness is held until then (story 1.23).

verbKey.description: Key of `strings.fr.json` (`verb.` group) of the verb shown above the threat (« SOULÈVE ! »). `null` = the default verb of the response, only for a `dodge` response (story 5.1).

icon.description: Glyph drawn in the threat's marker (the client has one per entry).

iconShape.description: Shape of the threat's marker: `circle` goes with `parry`, `triangle` with `dodge` (the pair is the signal, NFR8).

color.description: Colour of the threat's marker, by DESIGN.md token name (`parry` or `dodge`).

telegraph.description: Cue played when the threat is telegraphed.

success.description: Cue played on a successful response.

perfect.description: Cue played on a perfect response.

gag.description: Cue played when the gag is triggered.

signal.description: Only on a `wait` threat (required there, refused elsewhere): the cue played at the signal, when the window opens (story 4.6).

feedback.description: Cues of `feedback.json` › `cues` the client plays for this threat (story 1.11).

cooldownMs.description: Time spent resolved or in gag before the threat is idle again, in sim ms (0 = at once).

gagCryMs.description: When a miss ends in the gag, the baby cries for this long, in sim ms, at least 1000 (story 3.1: one `BabyCrying` per second, +2 % noise each; a shorter cry would be silent). Absent: the gag does not make him cry.

target.description: Where the threat stands: a planned anchor, or on Papa (system-spawned, story 1.19).

gag.description: The gag played on a miss (a `GAG_IDS` entry of the sim).

oneOf.description: A threat that stands on an anchor of the level, or on Papa.
